rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas-bootstrap-requirements/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill with front matter, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions`. The requirement obliges each site's description to state when to use the skill in terms of the user's task.

The description in the front matter does this. It begins "Use when adopting Habeas in an existing codebase, when `habeas status --coverage` warns about uncovered items across most of a project's code, or when the user asks for a requirements coverage audit." Those are situations the user is in and tasks the user asks for.

The description also says "For a few uncovered items, use habeas-evidence." That names another bundled skill an agent could confuse with this one. The requirement allows this with MAY, so it is not a gap.

No violation matches were listed, and I found no unmet obligation.
